To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the activity of disulfdide reductase is regulated by 3', 5'- AMP, ATP, GPT, UTP, Ca2+, Mg2+, protamine, noradrinalein and F- and that the effects of most of these regulators are connected with protein kinase.
the activity of disulfide reductase was increased by the following factors: 3',5'AMP, ATP, UTP, GTP, Mg2+ Ca2+, protamine, nor-epinephrine, and F-.

the activity of DRS was increased by 3', 5'-AMP, Mg2+, noradrenaline, protamine, GTP, ATP, UTP, EDTA and Ca2+ and that the effect was connected with the arsenite-resistant fraction of DRS and was prevented by protein kinase inhibitor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the mechanisms of regulation of the disulphide-reductase system in the liver of the mouse.
the study of regulation of disulfide reductase (DR) in the liver of mice.
the regulation of the enzyme system of disulphides in mouse liver.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DRS is regulated by the phosphorylation-dephosphorylation mechanism.
protein kinase is involved in activation of DSR with 3', 5'-AMP, noradrenalines, ATP, GPT, UTP, Ca2+, protamine and Mg.
protein kinase participates in the activation of DSR with 3', 5'-AMP, 3'-AMP, ATP and GTP and that the activation with protamine, Mg and Ca2+ is due to other mechanisms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DRS was a complex system of enzymes and the effect of regulators on DRS was due to their action on protein kinases.
DRS was activated by 3', 5-AMP, GTP and ATP, and that the effect of ATP was connected with the activation of protein kinase.
protein kinase is involved in activation of DSR with ATP, GTP and Mg2+ and that it is involved in activation with noradrenaline.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have identified an important new role for the Nrf1 transcription factor in regulating the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt) and the mitochondrial proteasome.
the effect of 2',5'-AMP on DRS is not connected with the activation of protein kinase.

the activation of disulphides by 3', 5'-AMP, protamine and noradrenalene may be connected with the activation of protein kinase and the activation of DSR by ATP, GTP and UTP may be connected with activation of phosphodiesterase.
